rules: No raw names, coordinates, or unprotected personal identifiers
operator_annotation must be a short coded note or hash — not free-text PII
Pressure unit must be declared as bar or psi
Timestamp timezone and sampling interval are mandatory
Event labels are supplied by the asset owner and never inferred by the loader
Archive remains on the owner's controlled storage
optional_channels are accepted for pilot correlation; only water_cut_pct currently reinforces water_breakthrough_candidate
esp_start_stop, existing_alarm, daily_report_flag, intervention_flag are passthrough for shadow journaling
